info.title: IGSN service API
info.description: Machine API of the IGSN registry, reading and writing published samples as IGSN Core v0.10.0 records. A service account authenticates every call with its api key.

apiKey.description: Bearer token holding the api key of a service account. A missing key and an unknown key both answer 403, so the api tells no caller whether a key exists.

data.description: Published samples the account can read, one IGSN Core record each.

total.description: Number of samples matching the query, every page taken together.

meta.description: Counters describing the whole result set.

CoreSampleList.description: One page of IGSN Core sample records.

schemaVersion.description: Version of IGSN Core the record follows.

recordId.description: Internal identifier of the record; emit only.

createdAt.description: When the sample was first created; emit only.

updatedAt.description: When the sample was last updated; emit only.

metadataLanguage.description: Languages the metadata is written in; emit only.

metadataVersion.description: Version of the metadata record; emit only.

eventType.description: What happened to the sample, only created, published and updated ever being emitted.

lifecycleEvents.description: Dated history of the sample; emit only.

record.description: Lifecycle metadata the registry owns; emit only.

sampleIdentifier.description: IGSN of the sample, minted by the registry; emit only, ignored on input.

landingPage.description: Public page of the sample on the registry; emit only.

titleType.description: Kind of title, always the main one.

titles.description: Name of the sample, exactly one title.

localName.description: Name the sample carries in its own collection.

identification.description: Identifiers and names of the sample.
